checks: The input retained caps are full-dimensional, compact and of centroid y_i by efa4558174ce60cf. Minkowski interpolation of interior balls puts the target mark in the interior of the superbody, where the same optimizer theorem applies.

Each uniform triangular map satisfies the pointwise telescoping derivative product equal to its cap volume. Its weighted sum is a bounded Borel triangular map, strictly increasing and continuously differentiable in each own coordinate with positive derivative for fixed prefix. The accepted Borel inverse and iterated substitution apply to the sum.

Normalizing the weights by lambda_i times s_i gives weighted AM–GM with product one and a positive probability density bounded above by s^(-d). Multiplying the law by s^d gives the physical domination bound on K and the correct mass and first moment.

At equality, uniqueness of the physical optimizer makes the dominated density an indicator almost everywhere. Its density is strictly positive on the Borel image and the pushforward is absolutely continuous, so J=s^d at almost every cube point. All positive AM–GM factors must be equalities, which gives derivative proportionality with factors s_i independent of the cube point.

In every orthonormal frame the first coordinates are one-dimensional projection quantiles. Their continuous positive derivatives extend the almost-everywhere identity to the interval, their means fix the additive constants, and their upper endpoints give actual support functions. Using every first-axis direction eliminates any freedom left by a single triangular frame.

The centered normalized caps coincide as compact convex bodies by support-function uniqueness. Their Minkowski combination is an admissible physical centroidal cap-volume optimizer at equality, and uniqueness makes it exactly the target cap. The converse follows from its exact volume, including one input and dimension one.
The statement matches original 38e8cdfda56d1d3d §2 and Theorem A. It identifies retained caps and does not assert rigidity of the whole input bodies.

dependencies.hypotheses: For each ordinary full-dimensional compact body and interior mark, supplies the unique a.e. optimizing indicator with positive mass and the given centroid, including the whole body at its centroid.

Its proof supplies the uniform conditional-quantile maps and the Borel inverse and iterated substitution for the weighted triangular sum. All cap bodies are full-dimensional and all positive mixture weights are admissible.

overlap.comparison: Its proof of joint concavity uses the same dominated barycentric law and applies the inequality on any containing body. It contains no equality criterion for the physical retained caps.
It gives a marked homothety equality for ordinary projective energy and whole bodies. The optimized integrand and its equality object differ from the physical retained density and its cap.

readability: The proof uses only derivatives in each map's own triangular coordinate. The step from equality of densities to equality of derivative products uses the pushforward being absolutely continuous and concentrated where its density is the target indicator.
review_method: Independent frozen-proof and source comparison with exact arithmetic where applicable
summary: The retained-volume inequality and its exact equality characterization follow for every positive weighted ordinary Minkowski combination with an arbitrary convex superbody.
